hangzhou.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: panoramic background illustration for an interactive Chinese poetry journey, no UI.
Primary request: A complete original Chinese ink-wash landscape of Hangzhou's West Lake evoking Su Shi's first tenure in 1071–1074. Elegant muted blue-green washes, ivory xuan paper, fine dry ink brush textures, generous luminous mist and negative space. This is an imaginative literary scene, not an archaeological reconstruction.
Scene: a small Northern Song wooden lakeside viewing pavilion on a low stone terrace left of center, a narrow willow-lined shoreline, a delicate lotus and reed bank toward the center, distant softly overlapping West Lake hills. A small simple lakeside pavilion at the far right shoreline. Willow branches frame the lower left edge, a few lotus leaves low in the foreground. Classical restrained painting, subtle asymmetry, tranquil summer rain clearing.
Composition: wide panorama approximately 12:7. World coordinates imagined as 2400x1400: left shore landing at x680 y855, middle low reed shore at x1140 y840, right pavilion at x1930 y775. Entire horizontal water strip from x600 to2200, y960 to1100 must remain unobstructed pale open water so an animated small boat can move there. Lower third predominantly open pale water with delicate ripples. Upper third and especially upper right are pale mist with very low visual contrast for overlaid vertical poetry. Foreground land must not obstruct water ribbon. Paint all background scenery in one flat image.
Avoid: boats, ships, people, Su Causeway (not yet built in this period), modern architecture, modern bridges, modern pagoda reconstructions, labels, Chinese characters, calligraphy, seals, signatures, watermarks, decorative border, UI. Do not place any text anywhere. No dramatic dark sky. Fine museum-quality ink brush illustration, airy and contemplative.

mizhou.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: panoramic background illustration for an interactive Chinese poetry journey, no UI.
Primary request: A complete original Chinese ink-wash landscape evoking Su Shi's Mizhou years 1074–1076, with northern hills, an understated Song-era terrace, autumn trees and a pale mid-autumn moon. This is an imagined literary landscape joining motifs from hunting, the Chaoran Terrace and moonlit poetry, not a literal geographical map or reconstruction.
Style: ivory xuan paper with very muted warm ochre and smoke-gray ink washes, restrained fine brushwork, large luminous negative spaces, quiet silver mist. Distinct from lush southern West Lake: sparse northern deciduous trees, low broad dry hills, grasses and weathered stone, no bamboo or lotus.
Composition: wide panorama approximately 12:7. World coordinates imagined as 2400x1400: at x680 y855 a simple reed-and-stone riverside path below autumn trees; around x1140 y840 a modest raised timber viewing terrace on a worn earthen city wall with simple Northern Song railings and roof; at x1930 y775 a low rocky bank beside thin bare trees. Low rolling hunting hills far left, no visible people required. A faint round moon at upper center left, dissolved into warm gray mist. Entire horizontal water strip from x600 to2200, y960 to1100 must remain unobstructed pale open river water for an animated small boat. Lower third predominantly open pale water, delicate ripples. Upper third and upper right have very low contrast mist for overlaid vertical poetry. Foreground dry branches at lower left only. Paint all scenery in a single flat image.
Avoid: boats, ships, people, hunting violence, Chinese characters, calligraphy, seals, signatures, text of any kind, watermarks, modern city, castle fantasy, tall pagodas, modern railings, decorative border, UI. No dramatic dark night; moonlight must still look like airy pale paper. Fine museum-quality ink brush illustration.
